scope: Twelve stable parent work items: C01-C06 and V01-V06. Historical issue IDs are references within these parents, not a second master list.

parents.title: Whole-product dependency and runtime security

children.failure: Fresh npm audit reports 17 findings: one critical and eight high; direct Next 16.1.6, Sharp 0.34.5, PostCSS 8.5.8 and DOMPurify 3.3.3 are affected by advisories requiring applicability triage.
children.impact: Untriaged production dependency exposure blocks the security acceptance criterion.
children.verification: Primary-advisory reachability dispositions, deterministic install, full and runtime audits, supported builds and relevant browser regressions.

children.failure: Current companion main does not contain the seven-file mobile commit 2ff1d82 that was present in the previous deployment.
children.verification: Account for each legitimate behavior while integrating current main, then run phone/tablet/desktop booking, cancellation, combo and chat journeys. The 34cc24c candidate restores mobile layout but independent review found additional behavior gaps.

children.version: current main 4ab0d699; deployed CLI artifact dpl_AUuC2Hb6ArcHKuPGNqnJS7p4Te6T has no Git fingerprint
children.failure: Fresh npm audit reports 14 findings: one critical and nine high; direct Next 16.1.6 and PostCSS 8.5.8 require advisory applicability triage.
children.impact: The separately enabled onboarding app cannot be omitted from release security and build acceptance.
children.verification: Confirm deployed source, inspect primary advisories and reachability, patch exact lock, run deterministic install, production build and onboarding regressions.

children.failure: Independent no-network repro shows the candidate follows an allowed-origin 302 to http://127.0.0.1:8080/private.png and returns a public immutable image response; it also accepts an evil-supabase.co suffix. The historical deployed route blocks both.
children.impact: A public image proxy can reach private destinations and cache their responses.
children.verification: Restore exact host/protocol, manual redirect, content-type and nosniff checks; prove forbidden redirects/suffixes fail and permitted images still work.

children.failure: The candidate's cancelled page only links Try Again to / and lacks the historical tenant-scoped unexpired HTTPS Yoco checkout resume and /my-bookings fallback.
children.impact: A returning customer can lose the approved payment-recovery path.
children.verification: Restore saved-session persistence and safe recovery, then test eligible, expired, foreign-tenant and absent sessions.

children.failure: Source comparison shows the candidate retains only two-leg combo fields where deployed code supports combo_offer_items and date/per-leg selection; candidate chat omits tenant-scoped chat_session and live-agent polling, and its CSP omits deployed Paysafe SDK allowances. The local backend requires the missing chat capability and all combo legs.
children.impact: Enabled combo, handoff and payment journeys would regress when replacing the deployed artifact.
children.verification: Reconcile actual deployed capability and test authorized multi-leg combo, tenant-scoped live-agent reply, and enabled payment SDK behavior in a bounded candidate environment.

children.version: 34cc24c candidate versus historically deployed 2ff1d82 and current backend contract
children.failure: Candidate uses an unscoped anonymous insert/read and calls create-checkout without the booking_token required by the current backend; it also omits historically deployed server-priced add-ons, returned amount/expiry and safe retry handling.
children.impact: Public booking or checkout can fail authorization, and preserving amount/retry truth is unverified.
children.verification: Restore the deployed capability-based flow and test anonymous booking, authorized checkout, add-ons, expiry, lost response and retry against disposable backend fixtures.

parents.local_evidence: npm ci, full and production-only audits with zero findings, TypeScript, Webpack production build and mocked WebP/AVIF image checks passed; existing lint reports 85 findings. Independent no-network proxy repro and source/backend contract comparison led fresh-context review dispatched as Astra xhigh to reject deployment for the recorded preservation/security regressions. Exact default Turbopack build remains unverified.
parents.next: Complete deployed-behavior reconciliation and bounded correction under Astra xhigh; re-review and verify before updating the Admin CI pin.

parents.title: Public authentication and recovery behavior

children.failure: Before the patch, reset response bodies and delivery failures exposed account state, recovery links trusted request origin, and login disclosed setup/suspension state before credential verification.
children.impact: Account enumeration and hostile recovery-link origin could compromise recovery.
children.verification: Independent review dispatched as Astra xhigh accepted the corrected two-commit patch after 202 focused tests, offline old/current AuthGate login execution, malformed reset isolation, actual installed Next after() lifecycle and diff checks. Deployed real-Auth/delivery and browser evidence remain.

parents.review: ACCEPTED by fresh-context Astra xhigh reviewer; effective runtime model/effort remains unobservable
parents.next: Under Astra-led routing, integrate the reviewed commits, check trusted ADMIN_RECOVERY_ORIGIN configuration without exposing its value, then verify deployed real-Auth/delivery/browser behavior with scoped approval.

parents.title: Production-safe rate limits and bounded resource use

children.failure: Production E2E_BYPASS_RATE_LIMIT is not rejected, Redis fetch has no explicit timeout, and fallback is a per-process Map while direct Auth/Edge paths bypass this proxy.
children.impact: Distributed abuse and unbounded limiter latency remain possible; a tiny shared IP allowance can deny legitimate staff.
children.verification: Negative production bypass/config tests, bounded outage tests, shared-office allowance, distributed abuse, direct-path and expensive-operation behavioral tests.

parents.next: Trace every ingress and supported workload, then correct effective limits without disabling controls.

parents.title: Upload validation and partial-failure reconciliation

children.failure: The guide route buffers an unbounded multipart file, trusts name/type, and leaves an operation-owned Drive object orphaned when the trip_photos insert fails; an alternate direct upload path also exists.
children.impact: Resource exhaustion, unsafe content and unreconciled private objects can result.
children.verification: Image-byte/size/dimension and ownership/demo tests, valid phone-photo behavior, provider-success/database-failure and interrupted retry proof.

parents.next: Inventory enabled Drive paths and implement bounded decoding and operation-owned reconciliation.

parents.title: Verified database TLS and effective permissions

children.failure: The drift checker explicitly sets rejectUnauthorized: false and compares only selected table grants, RLS flags and policies.
children.impact: Certificate spoofing can invalidate live drift evidence; effective grants and privileged functions may escape the baseline.
children.verification: Trusted and untrusted certificate tests plus disposable low-privilege effective-grant/function/view/storage tests.

parents.next: Fix certificate/hostname validation and extend effective privilege coverage without rubber-stamping a new baseline.

parents.title: Bulk acceptance and interruption recovery

children.failure: The full-batch endpoint starts an audit with a total but does not persist the complete accepted target list before processing; the foreground UI's remaining selections vanish on tab close.
children.impact: Interruption can leave accepted, completed, unknown and unsubmitted work hard to reconcile.
children.verification: Disposable database and provider-fault tests for tab loss, timeout, failed audit writes, actor/tenant switch and stable money-operation IDs.

parents.next: Preserve the approved per-item foreground contract; make whole-batch acceptance and interrupted results authoritative.

parents.title: Coordinated whole-product verification
parents.evidence: Dated synthetic 100-account continuity and focused regressions exist. Current inventory spans 49 Admin API files, 55 Edge Functions, five companion API files, and direct RPC/Storage paths; enabled capability and role-denial evidence is not yet complete.
parents.next: Map enabled paths, actual roles and positive/denied journeys to current candidate behavior; repeat same-record continuity on an isolated restore.
